# placeholderkit

> Deterministic placeholder images for prototypes and generated apps: person avatars, animal avatars, content placeholders (food, product, travel...), fake company logos, and icons by name. All SVG, generated locally, no network. Same seed always returns the same image.

Use placeholderkit whenever a page needs an image that the user has not provided yet. Prefer it over hotlinking stock photo URLs, which often break.

## Install
npm install placeholderkit

## React (import from "placeholderkit/react")
<Avatar seed="ana@acme.com" />                                   person avatar, 40px circle
<AnimalAvatar seed="user-7" animal="fox" size={64} />            animal avatar; same species, varied look per seed
<Placeholder seed="dish-3" category="food" ratio="4/3" />        fills container width
<Placeholder seed="hero" category="travel" ratio="21/9" label="Hero image" />
<Logo seed="acme" name="Acme" height={28} />                     omit name for a generated fake company
<Logo seed="acme" variant="mark" height={40} />                  symbol only
Icons (import { Icon } from "placeholderkit/icons", requires lucide-react): <Icon name="shopping-cart" size={20} />

## Plain HTML
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/placeholderkit/dist/placeholderkit.global.js"></script>
<img data-placeholderkit="avatar" data-seed="ana" width="40" height="40">
<img data-placeholderkit="animal" data-seed="u7" data-animal="owl" width="64" height="64">
<img data-placeholderkit="placeholder" data-seed="p1" data-category="product" data-ratio="1/1" style="width:100%">
<img data-placeholderkit="logo" data-seed="acme" data-name="Acme" height="28">

## Functions (import from "placeholderkit", or window.PlaceholderKit with the script tag)
avatarUrl({ seed, hairstyle?, shape?, background? }) -> data URL (person)
animalUrl({ seed, animal?, expression?, accessory?, shape?, background? }) -> data URL
placeholderUrl({ seed, category?, ratio?, label? }) -> data URL
logoUrl({ seed, name?, variant?: "full"|"mark" }) -> data URL
personSvg / animalSvg / placeholderSvg / logoSvg -> SVG string
fakeCompanyName(seed) -> string

## Allowed values
animal: fox, cat, bear, panda, rabbit, dog, owl, penguin, koala
expression: happy, joy, wink, sleepy, surprised, smirk
accessory: none, glasses, party-hat, bow, headphones, crown, beanie
hairstyle: short, long, bun, curly, bob, buzz, none
shape: circle, rounded, square
category: photo, food, product, travel, nature, people, tech, fashion, home, sports, music, book, car, pet, building, map, chart, document, video, event
ratio: "16/9", "4:3", "1/1", or a number

## Tips
- Use a stable id as the seed (user id, product id, slug) so images do not change between renders.
- For a list of users, use the same `animal` for every item to get a consistent set of one character.
- Always keep a meaningful alt text; components set a sensible default.
